title: Link run answer
description: What a gateway returns on its link to a run request it accepts, a 200, application/json, unsigned: the link's transport authenticates it. The run id echoed, the run's labels as the gateway holds them, the about.details keys the run credential decides, the policy in force for the run and its digest, the run's variables, the run's proxy secret, and the run's certificate authority exactly when the run request's wall is true. A member Forager does not recognise is ignored.

version.description: The document format. Forager refuses a version it does not read.

run_id.description: The run id of the request, echoed.

labels.description: The run's labels as the gateway holds them: the run credential's, through the operator's mapping, behind a separate gateway; the run request's on the local link. The session's dev.qory.run.started contains exactly these.

details.description: The about.details keys the run credential decides, those whose claims it carries, with the run credential's values. The session's dev.qory.run.started contains each with this value in about.details. Absent when the run credential decides none, and on the local link.

policy.description: The policy in force for the run: the one the gateway holds for it, narrowed by the request's narrowing when it has one. Absent when there is none, and the gateway observes everything.

digest.description: sha256 of the policy as canonical JSON, hex: the digest dev.qory.run.policy_applied reports for it.

variables.description: The variables the agent's process receives, as a run configuration contains them.

proxy_secret.description: The run's proxy secret: at least 128 bits from the system's random source, made by the gateway for this run. The relay opens every connection with it, and without a wall the agent's proxy URL carries it as its password. Compared in constant time, never logged, refused once its run ends, sent between machines only inside TLS. Characters a URL's password and the relay's preamble carry as they are.

certificate_authority.description: The certificate of the run's own certificate authority, PEM: present exactly when the run request's wall is true, absent when it is false. The certificate the enclosure trusts after the image's own; never its key, which stays with the gateway.
